- Late-arrival room access: we can pre-provision door codes and express check-in for attendees arriving after midnight; recommend sharing a single 4-digit access token per party + per-room keycode.

I attached the draft rate sheet and an initial master-bill template for your review. If this looks good I can push a provisional contract and DocuSign package today.

Thanks Erin — this is a helpful start. A few clarifying asks from our side before we sign: 

1) Master bill scope: please confirm the meeting-room hourly rates and whether AV technician labor will be on the master bill or charged to each team separately. We want AV on the master bill.

2) Incidental handling: we prefer to have individual incidentals billed to rooms, but need a single party to cover shuttle/host dinner on 5/18. Can you add a blanket folio code for the host dinner and a separate line item for shuttle invoice?

3) Late arrivals & key access: good to hear you can provision door codes. Two requests: (a) we need a list of code provisioning options (per-room vs per-party) and (b) an audit log of access codes issued (for security/compliance). Does your ops team retain those logs for 90 days?

4) Guest preferences: we will circulate dietary needs, ADA requests, and bed-type preferences. Please confirm if you can accept a CSV upload for bulk provisioning (will share format).

If all that checks, please send the provisional agreement + DocuSign link. We'll aim to finalize by Friday 5/7.

Appreciate it —
Hannah
Head of Operations (Events) | Redwood Inference
